title: Projects
text:
A selection of research and applied ML projects spanning NLP, deep learning, and data science.


Text Classification Using Embeddings for Luganda
Trained a topic classifier for the Luganda text corpus using Cohere embedding representations and an SVM with hyper-parameter search. Demonstrates NLP pipeline development for a low-resource Bantu language.

Python SVM Cohere API Scikit-learn Low-resource NLP



Water Quality Data Visualisation — Kampala
Interactive visualisation of water quality metrics across Kampala Central Division. Surfaces spatial patterns in sanitation data to support public health analysis.

R Data Visualisation Geospatial Public Health



Fine-Tune Alpaca for Any Language
Fine-tuned the Alpaca instruction-following model for multilingual language translation and topic classification tasks, exploring parameter-efficient adaptation of large language models.

Python LLaMA/Alpaca Fine-tuning Instruction Tuning NLP



Chest Opacity Detection from Ultrasound Images
Deep learning pipeline for detecting chest opacities in ultrasound images — a low-cost alternative to CT scans. Addresses the clinical need for affordable, non-ionising diagnostic tools in resource-constrained settings.

Python PyTorch Deep Learning Medical Imaging Computer Vision

title: Eric Peter Wairagala
text:
ML Engineer & NLP Researcher · African Language Technologies · Responsible AI
I build ML systems and conduct research on natural language processing for low-resource African languages. My work addresses the gap in AI tools for African language speakers — through machine translation, named entity recognition, gender bias detection, and explainable AI.
My research appears in venues including TACL and AMTA. I have contributed to large-scale African NLP benchmarks such as MasakhaNER and multilingual translation datasets. I am actively seeking a PhD position to advance research at the intersection of low-resource NLP, responsible AI, and computational linguistics for African languages.
